title: Clear Digits from String
problemStatement: You are given a string consisting of lowercase English letters and digits. Process the string from left to right: If the current character is a lowercase letter, keep it. If the current character is a digit, remove the closest lowercase letter to its left that has not already been removed, and discard the digit itself. Return the final string after processing all characters.
constraints: 1 <= s.length <= 10^5 s consists only of lowercase English letters and digits. Every digit has at least one removable letter to its left.
